t: A DFRobot classroom kit that pairs an AI vision sensor with micro:bit projects.
steps: Find the study pack on the DFRobot site or at a retailer.
Check whether the listing includes the HuskyLens and micro:bit.
Assemble the modules following the wiki.
Connect the micro:bit to a computer by USB.
Start with lesson one of the 12 lessons.
Teach the HuskyLens to learn a face or a color.
Move on to a project such as the object tracker.
